briefdescription.para: This function sends an IPI request to get the XilLoader library version and capability bits running on the PLM.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the client instance. On SSIT parts, the SlrIndex field selects the SLR whose loader info is queried.
Pointer to Xil_LibInfo. LibVersion and Capability are filled on success. The Version and NistStatus fields are reserved for XilLoader and must be ignored.

listitem.para: XST_INVALID_PARAM if any input parameter is invalid.
Perform input parameter validation. Return error if parameters are invalid.

inbodydescription.para: Query library info via the Features command using a valid command id as the selector, so the command succeeds and the server returns the library version/capability at fixed indices. The SlrIndex is folded into the API id so the request is routed to the intended SLR on SSIT parts.
